title: Initialise the folder
summary: init prepares a working directory. Backend configuration controls where state is stored; this practice keeps remote backends disabled.
introduction: init prepares a working directory. Backend configuration controls where state is stored; this practice keeps remote backends disabled. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: init prepares a working directory. Backend configuration controls where state is stored; this practice keeps remote backends disabled.
In the built-in example, Terraform prepares the local directory. Other projects may download providers or modules during init.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Read the configuration before initialising a project.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: init does not mean a configuration is safe to apply.
For more detail later, use this [Terraform further reading](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials).
